name: LastPass Users
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the REKT article excerpt.
rootCause: Your keys, their coins. Since December 2022, a slow-burn wallet draining campaign has been underway, totalling over $37M so far. The thefts appear to be linked to LastPass which suffered two hacks last year. Who do you trust with your seed phrase, anon?
